title: THE DOUBLE-Z EXPONENT (LEAN): m = k_B T_0(1+z*)/sigma^2 with sigma^2 = (1/2) sqrt(G M_b a0), a0 = c^2/(Z R_dS) -- the Z-dependence of m is Z^(+1/2) EXACTLY and m(2Z)/m(Z) = sqrt(2) exactly

toolchain.note: the only 'sorry' string in the file is the docstring's 'Zero sorry.' declaration

theorems.theorem_1_exponent_flip: 1/(k x^(-1/2)) = x^(+1/2)/k for x > 0, x^(-1/2) := 1/sqrt(x), x^(+1/2) := sqrt(x) -- the reciprocal-square-root algebra at the field level
theorems.theorem_2_sqrt_recip: sqrt(1/y) = 1/sqrt(y) for y > 0 (the flip on the sqrt itself)
theorems.theorem_3_sqrt_mul_pos: sqrt(A*B) = sqrt(A) sqrt(B) for 0 < A, 0 < B (two-factor product, squared both sides)
theorems.theorem_4_ladder_sqrt_pair: sqrt(G M_b c^2/(Z R_dS)) * sqrt(Z R_dS/(G M_b)) = c -- sigma^2 carries Z^(-1/2), the inverse flips it to Z^(+1/2)
theorems.theorem_5_ladder_closed_form: m = k_B T/sigma^2 = (2 k_B T/c) sqrt(Z R_dS/(G M_b)) EXACTLY, sigma^2 := (1/2) sqrt(G M_b c^2/(Z R_dS))
theorems.theorem_6_z_exponent: sqrt(Z R_dS/(G M_b)) = sqrt(Z) sqrt(R_dS/(G M_b)) -- the Z^(+1/2) factor separates
theorems.theorem_7_z_dependence_of_m: m = (2 k_B T/c) sqrt(Z) sqrt(R_dS/(G M_b)) -- m carries Z^(+1/2) exactly, Z-independent prefactor
theorems.theorem_8_double_z_scaling: m(2Z)/m(Z) = sqrt(2) EXACTLY (2Z doubles Z inside a0 = c^2/(Z R_dS))
theorems.theorem_9_z_squared_exact: (2 sqrt(8 pi/3))^2 = 32 pi/3 exactly (Z = sqrt(32 pi/3), Z > 0)
theorems.theorem_10_sqrt_z_sqrt_form: sqrt(Z) = sqrt(sqrt(32 pi/3)) exactly -- the A08 '(32 pi/3)^(1/4)' content in sqrt-of-sqrt form (no rpow)
